title: Field Trip Permission Slip Form
subtitle: An original operational permission slip for field trip that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Field Trip Permission Slip Form supports the complete field trip workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Field Trip Permission Slip Form when the assigned trip lead needs one fillable record for trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Field trip permission slip identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this permission slip to one trip participant, itinerary, transport, supervision, and return record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Field trip record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Field trip scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Field trip requested participation and permission scope
sections.guidance: Separate each requested activity and condition so one choice does not imply another.

blocks.label: Field trip permission choices
items: Participation in the named destination and trip window
Use of the documented transport or walking plan
Participation in listed instructional activities
Use of listed meals or snacks under the current plan
Use of accessibility or participation supports already approved
Emergency contact using the supplied routing information
Alternate return or pickup plan only when separately documented
Declined or excluded activities recorded without changing other permissions
blocks.guidance: Each item is independent; document any exclusion or condition in the scope table.

blocks.label: Permission and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records a field-trip workflow; it does not replace guardian permission, qualified medical direction, transportation rules, emergency services, or local supervision requirements. Stop movement or release when identity, headcount, authorization, health support, or safety cannot be confirmed. Share only minimum necessary information and route decisions to the authorized reviewer.

sections.title: Field trip guardian routing, readiness, and support review
sections.guidance: Confirm contact, release, support, and stop conditions before relying on the permission record.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring review before participation
items: Permission or roster status is missing or inconsistent
Student is present but not assigned to the trip group
Destination, activity, route, or vehicle changed
Departure, transfer, or return headcount does not reconcile
Required support, medication custodian, or accessible transport is unavailable
Guardian or authorized release arrangement cannot be confirmed
Student is separated, missing, ill, injured, or in immediate distress
Weather, site, transport, or emergency authority issues a stop or change

blocks.label: Participation support, limitation, owner, and evidence
Guardian questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

fields.label: Questions, participant needs, assumptions, and unresolved conditions

sections.title: Field trip permission decision and authorization
sections.guidance: Preserve approved, declined, conditional, and unresolved scope as separate decisions.

blocks.label: Field trip permission decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the program administrator, guardian, and qualified health or emergency reviewer.

blocks.label: Decision rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

fields.label: Rationale, approved limits, exception path, and communication plan

sections.title: Field trip permission exceptions and operating handoff
sections.guidance: Do not force agreement; assign unresolved scope and communicate operating limits.

blocks.label: Permission exception and stop indicators
items: Trip cannot start under the documented plan
Student participation status needs guardian or administrator review
Transport, destination, or supervision arrangement changed
Health, allergy, medication, or support plan cannot be followed
Emergency, missing-student, or immediate safety response is active
Return, authorized release, or final headcount remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, immediate control, owner, escalation, and disposition
Approved-scope handoff requirements
items: Approved and declined scope communicated to assigned staff
Conditions and stop points visible at the point of use
Guardian and qualified-review sources linked
Release, transport, or setting limits routed when applicable
Unresolved permission has an owner and due point
Completion evidence and record location identified

sections.title: Field trip outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Field trip closeout controls
items: Final headcount and roster status accepted
Guardian or school return communication recorded
Unresolved incident or support need has an owner
Equipment and private records returned to approved custody
Transport or destination follow-up reference linked
Trip record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Permission Slip closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
